message: Both sample-checked references and validators agree on this executed failing input. Reduced locally; global minimality is not claimed.
explanation: The program uses a greedy approach, sorting items by value-to-weight ratio and picking items sequentially. For the given input, both items have an equal ratio (1/1 and 2/2). The code considers item (1, 1) first, taking 1 weight and yielding value 1, which leaves remaining capacity 1 and prevents item (2, 2) from fitting. Consequently, it outputs 1 instead of the optimal knapsack value 2 obtained by selecting item (2, 2).
